semiconductor_relevance: High — VERMES Microdispensing specializes in precision dispensing systems that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: VERMES Microdispensing provides advanced piezo-based contact-free dispensing systems that deliver high-speed and precise dispensing of micro, nano, and sub-nanoliter volumes. Their technology is applicable across various materials used in semiconductor manufacturing, making them a key player in the equipment segment.
capabilities: Dispensing of adhesives, silicones, solder pastes, and cell suspensions
